en.name: LFM2.5 Embedding 350M
en.description: Search short passages across eleven languages with a local 354M-parameter model.
en.long_description:
Embed short passages in eleven languages with Liquid AI's 354M-parameter retrieval model. This Bit downloads a pinned community ONNX conversion by dsaad68, with dynamically quantized int8 weights. It produces 1,024-dimensional normalized vectors and uses a 512-token input window. Query and document prefixes are applied automatically.

Compatible local hosts run the model on the device. The OpenRouter fallback remains configured, but OpenRouter currently lists no active endpoint for this model. Hosted execution is unavailable until a provider restores that endpoint. If restored, the remote provider may retain successful requests and embeddings and use them to train Liquid models.

Quantization can change vectors across CPU architectures and batch sizes. Keep an index on the same execution path, and rebuild it when changing models or switching between local and hosted inference.

Model weights use the LFM Open License v1.0. The license includes a commercial revenue threshold; review the bundled terms before deployment.
en.use_case: Local semantic search over short passages, FAQs, product descriptions, and notes.
